scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 24 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: For 38 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

places-the-coastal-fort-shanetz-the-wate.story: A 173 km round trip from Kronstadt - roughly 2 h 59 in the saddle. On the way it passes Terioki, The Park «Nearest Dubki», The Water-bringing system of Peterhof and back through The Park «Nearest Dubki». It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.
